fn Stairs(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n <= 1) then 1 else (Stairs((n - 2)) + Stairs((n - 1)))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (Stairs(0) == 1)
  example (Stairs(2) == 2)
{
  if (n <= 1) then 1 else (Stairs((n - 2)) + Stairs((n - 1)))
}

fn ClimbStairs(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == Stairs(n))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (ClimbStairs(0) == 0)
